title: GROUND POINTS
ocr_text:
The ground points circuit diagram shows the connections from all major parts to the respective ground points. When troubleshooting a faulty ground point, checking the system circuits which use a common ground may help you identify the problem ground quickly. The relationship between ground points ( [symbol], [symbol], and [symbol] shown below) can also be checked this way.
